recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If Patient Care wants Organization restored, a new decision should explicitly reverse FHIR-39602 and update the authoritative Condition StructureDefinition and generated diagrams together.
issue_request: FHIR-32774 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care request for R5 asking that Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter allow Organization when only the organization that recorded or asserted the Condition is known.
initial_application: The issue was initially addressed through FHIR-34395, which replaced Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter with Condition.participant.actor and added Organization and CareTeam to that participant actor target list in commit 431d503d4443c0860a10a57b4704b1f0876ab099.
additional_context: FHIR-39602 later reversed the participant pattern, restored explicit Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter, and explicitly declined Organization support because PractitionerRole can support that use case. FHIR-41403 later added Group to both active elements, confirming that target-profile additions are made explicitly under the restored model.
reconciliation: The authoritative build-scope source has active Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter elements without Organization, while the old participant.actor block containing Organization is commented out. This matches the later FHIR-39602 decision, so the reconciliation published an empty no-change audit commit.
